audit.whatIsWrong: The chart is inverted on all seven rows. Content and full read Skill/Graves/Graves/Graves/Skill/Skill/Graves; the packet reads Ziggs on six rows and Skill at level 3. The prose is unambiguous and agrees with the packet everywhere — whys[0] 'you simply concede the level', whys[1] "you still can't reach him", whys[2] 'so it's skill-dependent', whys[3] 'punish every approach', whys[4] 'his disengage usually wins the exchange', whys[6] "you can't close, so you can't win the duel". The lane is also labelled EVEN at 5.5/10.
audit.why: Worst chart mismatch in the slice. The page's own text says Graves loses every phase except one coin-flip window, and the chart told him he wins five of seven — in a 43.48% lane against a champion he cannot reach.
audit.corrected: All seven rows set to the packet chart with ratings 3/3/5/3/3/2/2; diff to TRICKY, diffRating 7/10, carryRating 7/10, and both difficulty lines rewritten.

audit.why: The spike story is right: level 3 is the only window, level 6 adds a kill threat that Satchel Charge answers, and his first siege item ends the lane. Satchel Charge's 20/18/16/14/12s is the number that makes 'commit on its cooldown' actionable.
audit.corrected: 20s added to phases[4], mid, dosFull[2] and wants.you[1].

audit.whatIsWrong: mid contains a compound error: 'Smoke Screen's blind only stops his autos, not his abilities'. The second half of that sentence is a correct and useful warning; the first half is false. Graves' W is not a blind and does not stop his autos either — Riot's text is a cloud that reduces sight range, plus damage and a brief slow on impact. late repeats it as 'you can't blind a bomb'. Also 'two E charges' four times — Quickdraw is one dash on 16/15/14/13/12s refreshed by landing autos — and 'R as the disengage knockback', which Collateral Damage does not have.
audit.why: Here the blind error is load-bearing in the wrong direction: the page uses it to reassure the player that W at least stops autos. It stops neither. What it actually buys — sight denial and a slow on a champion whose whole plan is spacing — is better advice and is what the rewrite says.
audit.corrected: W described as a nearsight plus impact slow throughout, charges removed, R described as a nuke.

audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull[2].d calls a wasted Satchel Charge a 'fifteen-second invitation'.
audit.why: It is 20 seconds at rank 1 and 12 at rank 5 — the number moves enough over the lane that the invented one is wrong at both ends.

Nothing about MR is prescribed against a champion whose damage is entirely magic and partly percent-health — but the page correctly says armor stacking does nothing here, which is the actionable half.

edits.before: E online — dash-reload weaving starts: auto, E for the grit armor and reset, auto again. Most champs lose this flat.
edits.after: His Q bounces over the wave every 6 seconds at rank 1, and you still have no way to reach him or punish it.

edits.before: Full kit: Q's wall-bounce return is your real damage — fight near terrain so both hits connect.

edits.before: Trade in shell rhythm: two autos and out. Track Satchel Charge; your armor stacks from E make his short trades unprofitable.
edits.after: Hexplosive Minefield sits on every approach lane, and stacking armor does nothing against magic chip you can't out-range.

edits.before: Collateral Damage adds an execute and a disengage knockback in one — hold it for either, never for chip.
edits.after: Satchel Charge knocks you out of your own all-in — 20s at rank 1, and you go only on its downtime.

edits.before: First item spike — the point-blank Q-AA-E-AA pattern now removes half bars. Force fights near walls.
edits.after: His first siege item zones you off the wave entirely — take what CS you can and roam instead.

edits.before: You out-skirmish but the crit scalers pass you — convert to picks with smoke-screen blinds and R snipes.
edits.after: A farmed artillery Ziggs out-ranges everything you own, R included — never try to solo-siege him.

edits.before: Ziggs burns Satchel Charge on nothing — take the fifteen-second invitation.
edits.after: Ziggs burns Satchel Charge on nothing — that is 20 seconds of invitation at rank 1.

edits.before: Play assassin-marksman: smoke their engage, E through fights for armor, and save R as either the execute or the peel knockback. Crit carries out-DPS you — picks don't care.
edits.after: Play assassin-marksman: smoke their engage, E through fights for armor, and save the 100-second R for the kill, never the chip. Artillery out-ranges you — picks don't care.

edits.before: Your W smoke blinds tower dives and breaks gank pathing — drop it on arrival and turn their 2v1 into a coin flip you win.
edits.after: Your W smoke nearsights tower dives and breaks gank pathing — drop it on arrival and turn their 2v1 into a coin flip you win.

edits.before: Your first real chance — two E charges let you Quickdraw in and burst before he can reposition, but it's a coin-flip on his Satchel Charge and positioning, so it's skill-dependent.
edits.after: Your first real chance — Quickdraw lets you close and burst before he repositions, but it's a coin-flip on his 20-second Satchel Charge and his spacing, so it stays skill-dependent.

edits.before: Your first real window: two E charges let you Quickdraw the gap and unload the point-blank 4-shell spread plus Q-detonate. Save your dash for the gap-close, not for trading autos.
edits.after: Your first real window: Quickdraw closes the gap and you unload the point-blank 4-shell spread plus a Q detonation. Save the dash for the gap-close, never for trading autos.

edits.before: Level 3 is your one honest window: two E charges let you Quickdraw the gap, drop Smoke Screen on him to gut his vision range and slow him, then unload the point-blank 4-shell burst plus a Q detonation. Note that Smoke Screen's blind only stops his autos, not his abilities — it won't cancel a bomb, so use the cloud for the slow and vision-cut, not to 'whiff' his Q. Commit only when his Satchel Charge is on cooldown, because that knockback shoves you right back out of range mid-combo and strands you in his E minefield. At 6 your R adds the kill threat, but you still need his W down AND a path in — if he respects you and pokes from max range, you simply cannot start the fight.
edits.after: Level 3 is your one honest window: Quickdraw closes the gap, drop Smoke Screen on him to gut his sight range and slow him, then unload the point-blank 4-shell burst plus a Q detonation. Smoke Screen is a nearsight, not a blind — it cuts what he can see and slows him on impact, and it will not cancel a bomb, so use it to break his spacing rather than to make him whiff. Commit only when Satchel Charge is down — 20 seconds at rank 1 — because that knockback shoves you back out of range mid-combo and strands you in his minefield. At 6 your R adds a kill threat, but you still need his W down AND a path in — if he pokes from max range you cannot start the fight at all.

edits.before: This is where it gets ugly. Once Ziggs has Liandry's or Blackfire Torch his Q poke and E minefield zone you off the wave entirely, and your True Grit armor/MR stacking does little against his percent-health magic chip from a range you can't answer. Smoke Screen can't save you here — you can't blind a bomb, and the cloud is melted before you'd ever close the gap. Your only path to relevance is to have snowballed an early gank or the Level 3 window into a roam/skirmish lead, because a farmed artillery Ziggs out-ranges every tool you own — even Collateral Damage — and will never give you the all-in. Push the wave, roam to flank with your team, and never try to solo-siege him.

notes: This page had the most dangerous single sentence in the slice: 'Smoke Screen's blind only stops his autos, not his abilities.' The caveat is right and the premise is invented — W is a sight-range cut plus an impact slow and stops neither. The chart was also inverted on all seven rows against the page's own prose, on a 43.48% matchup the text describes as unwinnable in a straight duel. Both fixed.
